attempts.summary: Configured node1's password policy via a pwquality.conf.d drop-in (minlen=12, minclass=3), confirmed it's wired into PAM (system-auth/password-auth already require pam_pwquality.so), validated enforcement end-to-end with real passwd attempts by an actual (non-root) user both before and after a full node reboot, and confirmed the boot identity changed to prove the restart was genuine.
